name: @aryacode/dsh-arya-maildesk
description: Zero-credential Outlook automation for DSH Harness on Windows: the AI agent drives your LOCAL desktop Outlook client via COM: search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address book, rooms, free/busy. No Graph API app registration, no SMTP passwords, no tenant admin rights. Anything that leaves the machine (send mail / meeting invite) passes a three-layer human gate: two-call confirmation + content-hash binding (the confirmed retry must match what the user last saw) + an independent one-time token the bridge demands. A NewMailEx watcher pushes arrivals to a sidebar badge and the maildesk_check_new tool, and a three-pane panel gives the mailbox a real face: folders, a selectable message list, an HTML reading pane with Proofpoint links unwrapped and remote images blocked, and mark/move/delete on the selection; a composer that keeps drafts in the harness instead of stacking them in Outlook, and sends only after the exact content is confirmed. A draft opened from chat appears as a card in the conversation, points at the same harness draft, and can be finished in the panel or sent from the card.
